lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
Compliance memo CM-2006-004: phase-out of lead chromate pigments
To: Production, Purchasing, QC, Process Engineering. From: R. Gallina, EHS.
Following requirements from our OEM customers (agricultural and earth-moving
machinery) and the ARAPO regional programme on heavy metals, all lead and chromate
pigments will be removed from our formulations by 31 December 2006.
AF-12: basic lead chromate CL-77 will be replaced by zinc phosphate ZP-40 from
Fosfazinco Nord (qualification in progress, see SQ-2007-002). Last CL-77 delivery:
October 2006. The supply agreement with Cromopigmenti Lazzeretti ends on
Other products: no lead pigments in use.
